provenance.source: Built-in authored demo input, explicitly labelled in the application. This film demonstrates the complete creation workflow; it is separate from real-model inference evidence.
provenance.footage: The full Playwright page recording from start through close is preserved. No synthetic UI, replacement scenes, cuts, added captions, sound, or retiming.

transcode.command: ffmpeg -threads 2 -i INPUT -map 0:v:0 -an -sn -dn -c:v libx264 -threads 2 -preset medium -crf 21 -pix_fmt yuv420p -fps_mode vfr -movflags +faststart public/showcase/workflow.mp4

validationMethod: Full FFmpeg -xerror framemd5 decode of original and output, with timestamp passthrough. Identical frame counts, dimensions and decoded durations verify preservation of the entire source; lossy H.264 frame hashes are not expected to equal VP8 hashes.
workflowMarkerReference: Approximate action markers in docs/production-validation.json use harness elapsed time and are not exact recording timestamps.
